question: The compound interest on ₹20,000 at 5% per annum, compounded annually, is ₹2,050. What is the time period?
solution:
**Given:**

Compound Interest = ₹2050

Rate = 5%

Principal = ₹20,000

**Concept Used:**

Compound Interest = P[(1 + R/100)T - 1]

**Calculation:**

Compound Interest = P[(1 + R/100)T - 1]

⇒ 2050 = 20000[(1 + 5/100)T - 1]

⇒ 2050/20000 = (1 + 5/100)T​ - 1

⇒ 2050/20000 +1 = (1 + 1/20)T​ 

⇒ 22050/20000 = (21/20)T​

⇒ 441/400 = (21/20)T​

⇒ (21/20)² = (21/20)T​

⇒ T = 2 years

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
